title: In-raid player report (draft 0.1.0)
description: One player report as the site stores it in the inbox; the private engine reads it. Numbers only: no images, no OCR. The site fills in id, submitted_at and client; the player supplies the rest and confirms the damage shown back formatted (e.g. "223.16 亿") before sending. Damage is in 0.1B (1e8) units.

id.description: Set by the site (UUID v4), so the engine can de-duplicate pulls and point DQ results at one report.

rank_pc.description: The rank as a percentage, as the game shows it (up to 2 decimals; more is a DQ flag, not a schema error). Exactly one of rank_pc and rank_n is present.

rank_n.description: The numeric rank. The game shows a number only to its top 200, so anything else arrives as rank_pc.

damage.description: In 0.1B (1e8) units. The upper bound is a units guard: a raw in-game score (> 1e6) typed without conversion fails here instead of reaching the engine.

read_at.description: When the player read the value in game, as they entered it.

submitted_at.description: Set by the site when it accepted the report.

client.description: Anti-abuse summary. Never an IP address or an account.

rate_key.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the rate-limit key, salted on the site so it can't be reversed to an address.
